item.title: Live progress counter during auto sessions
item.intent: During any auto session, users can see at a glance how many items have completed, how many failed, and how long the session has been running — they are never left wondering if the tool is still working or how far through the backlog it is.
item.description: auto sessions can run for 30-60+ minutes processing many items. The current output shows per-sprint status but gives no session-level view: users cannot tell if they are 2 items in or 18 items in, how many have failed so far, or how long the session has been running. A persistent status line printed at the start of each new sprint gives users a live session view without requiring them to scroll back. This complements FEAT-030 (bell notification) and FEAT-031 (--limit N) to make auto sessions fully transparent.
steps: Track session start time in run_sprint_loop using date +%s at session open
Increment items_completed counter on each sprint success; items_failed on each failure
At start of each sprint iteration, compute elapsed minutes and print: 'Sprint session: N complete | M failed | Xm elapsed'
When ready-item count is known before the loop, show 'N/total' format; otherwise show 'N complete'
acceptanceCriteria: Each new sprint in an auto session prints a session progress line before per-sprint output
Line shows items completed, items failed, and elapsed time in minutes
Format: 'Sprint session: N complete | M failed | Xm elapsed'
